import pathlib, subprocess, textwrap, shutil
base=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\geodata')
uv=shutil.which('uv') or r'C:\Users\TONECOS\.local\bin\uv.exe'
script=base/'profile_sgb_dem.py'
script.write_text(textwrap.dedent(r'''
import rasterio, math, statistics
from pyproj import Transformer
from pathlib import Path

grid=Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\vendor\geodata\sgb_mde_salvador\MDE\mde')
origin_lon=-38.5129247; origin_lat=-12.9745411
LOW=(-40.431,43.761)
HIGH=(-2.5779,8.2384)
TOWER=(-47.1903,50.1044)
GALLERY=(-5.2817,10.7757)
with rasterio.open(grid) as ds:
    tr=Transformer.from_crs('EPSG:4326',ds.crs,always_xy=True)
    ox,oy=tr.transform(origin_lon,origin_lat)
    def z_at(x,y):
        return float(next(ds.sample([(ox+x,oy+y)]))[0])
    def neighborhood(name,p,r=10,step=5):
        vals=[]
        for dx in range(-r,r+1,step):
            for dy in range(-r,r+1,step):
                if dx*dx+dy*dy <= r*r:
                    z=z_at(p[0]+dx,p[1]+dy)
                    if z != ds.nodata: vals.append(z)
        print('NEIGHBOR',name,'n',len(vals),'min',round(min(vals),2),'median',round(statistics.median(vals),2),'mean',round(statistics.mean(vals),2),'max',round(max(vals),2))
    for name,p in [('LOW',LOW),('TOWER',TOWER),('HIGH',HIGH),('GALLERY',GALLERY)]: neighborhood(name,p)
    dx=HIGH[0]-LOW[0]; dy=HIGH[1]-LOW[1]; dist=math.hypot(dx,dy)
    print('PROFILE_DISTANCE_M',round(dist,3))
    n=max(2,int(dist/5)+1)
    vals=[]
    for i in range(n+1):
        t=i/n; x=LOW[0]+dx*t; y=LOW[1]+dy*t; z=z_at(x,y); vals.append(z)
        print('PROFILE',round(t,4),round(t*dist,2),round(x,3),round(y,3),round(z,2))
    print('PROFILE_MIN',min(vals),'MAX',max(vals),'DELTA_ENDPOINTS',round(vals[-1]-vals[0],2))
'''),encoding='utf-8')
r=subprocess.run([uv,'run','--with','rasterio','--with','pyproj','python',str(script)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
print('RETURN',r.returncode)
print(r.stdout)
print(r.stderr)
if r.returncode!=0: raise RuntimeError('profile failed')
